entries.title: A self-contained live changelog
entries.description: The activity feed now reads its published update file directly from the website, avoiding per-visitor GitHub API requests while continuing to refresh automatically.

commits.message: Serve the live changelog from the published site

entries.title: A changelog that tells the story, not just the commits
entries.description: Related development changes are now grouped into readable updates, with a clear explanation for visitors and expandable links to the original commits. The feed is generated automatically whenever project changes are pushed.

entries.title: Latest Changelog stays interactive in Crystal mode
entries.description: The changelog panel is now excluded from the page-dimming interaction rules, so visitors can keep reading and scrolling without the Crystal experience closing underneath them.

commits.message: Exclude Latest Changelog from Crystal page blur

entries.title: Ursa Major now welcomes first-time visitors
entries.description: New visitors now enter Crystal mode with Ursa Major selected by default. Existing saved constellation arrangements are preserved.

commits.message: Set Ursa Major as the default Crystal constellation

entries.title: A clearer, more readable Poetry Index
entries.description: The five movements now appear in a single vertical column, making the archive easier to scan and navigate.

commits.message: Align Poetry Index as a single vertical column
